[F008] I've implemented F008 for plan 2026-06-21-001 (target: dev, host-local, no cloud project). I added two projections fed by the F005 `UpgradeReport`: `upgrade_status_projection` (the always-rendered Tools & Setup / Health status row carrying `status_line`, `update_state`, pending counts, separate `last_seen_commit`/`installed_commit`, `upstream_status`, and `marker_state`) and `provide_upgrade_actions` (the drill-down `ActionItem`s with `source='upgrade'`, mapping probe-pending required → `needs_action` with its first apply-labeled command, undismissed advisory → `advisory`, satisfied/dismissed absent), both in a new `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/upgrade_dashboard.py`. I extended the closed source vocabulary in `operator_console.py` (`SOURCE_UPGRADE` added to `_VALID_SOURCES`, `_SOURCE_PRIORITY`, and `__all__`, D052), and wired both projections into the dashboard build path (`_gather_action_items` aggregation + GLOBAL scope, and an always-written `upgrade-status.json` next to `what-now.json`), all read-only with no network fetch. The status line never reads "up to date" while upstream is behind (D031), the acknowledgement renders `last_seen_commit` not `installed_commit` (D037), and an absent marker renders "never acknowledged" (D042). The new 14-test suite passes and is captured at `evidence/F008-test-output.txt` (D048); related suites stayed green (F005/F006 62 passed; operator_console/render_gate/scope/relevance/action-spine 116 passed; dashboard build-path tests 27 passed)
